name: Stand by Say you!
source:
Main character is a son of voice actor who suddenly becomes anime sound director after previous sound director withdrawal. He needs to maintain some quality level and operate within time limits to produce full season of anime "Interrupt Girl".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是声优的儿子，在之前的声音总监退出后突然成为动画声音总监。他需要保持一定的质量水平并在规定的时间内完成动画《打断女孩》的整季制作。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-march-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
